command: import json,os,sys; p="build/stm32f405-qemu.elf"; ok=os.path.isfile(p); print(json.dumps({"ok":ok,"status":"completed" if ok else "failed","artifact":p,"sizeBytes":os.path.getsize(p) if ok else 0})); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import json,os,pathlib,re,signal,subprocess,sys,time
artifact=pathlib.Path("build/stm32f405-qemu.elf")
state=pathlib.Path('.state/qemu')
pid_file=state/'qemu.pid'
log_file=state/'qemu.log'
uart=pathlib.Path(".state/qemu/uart")
def running(pid):
  try: os.kill(pid,0); return True
  except (ProcessLookupError,PermissionError): return False
if not artifact.is_file(): print(json.dumps({'ok':False,'status':'failed','error':'artifact_missing','artifact':str(artifact)})); sys.exit(2)
state.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
try: old_pid=int(pid_file.read_text().strip())
except (FileNotFoundError,ValueError): old_pid=None
if old_pid and running(old_pid):
  os.kill(old_pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  for _ in range(20):
    if not running(old_pid): break
    time.sleep(0.1)
pid_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
uart.unlink(missing_ok=True)
stream=log_file.open('w',encoding='utf-8')
proc=subprocess.Popen(['qemu-system-arm','-M','netduinoplus2','-cpu','cortex-m4','-kernel',str(artifact),'-nographic','-monitor','none','-serial','pty'],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
stream.close()
pid_file.write_text(f'{proc.pid}\n')
pty=None
for _ in range(30):
  time.sleep(0.1)
  content=log_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') if log_file.exists() else ''
  match=re.search(r'(/dev/pts/\d+)',content)
  if match: pty=match.group(1); break
  if proc.poll() is not None: break
if proc.poll() is not None or not pty:
  if proc.poll() is None: os.kill(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  pid_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
  print(json.dumps({'ok':False,'status':'failed','error':'qemu_start_failed' if proc.poll() is not None else 'qemu_uart_pty_missing','exitCode':proc.poll(),'artifact':str(artifact),'logTail':content[-2000:]}))
  sys.exit(proc.poll() or 1)
uart.symlink_to(pty)
print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'action':'download','status':'running','pid':proc.pid,'artifact':str(artifact),'uartPath':str(uart),'uartTarget':pty,'immutableHarness':True}))
